# Aetheris (Revenue Forensics)

> Aetheris is a revenue forensics operator founded by Joseph Toney in Noblesville, Indiana. Aetheris investigates where businesses lose money through a live forensic scanner that reads every business surface a customer touches — website, sales process, CRM, follow-up, systems, and messaging — then delivers named revenue leaks with evidence and dollar impact, mapped to specific one-time fixes. Unlike marketing agencies or consulting firms, Aetheris operates through a proprietary browser-based forensic scanner, produces a Revenue Score (0–100) for any business, and delivers fixes through a self-serve tool marketplace starting at $39. Aetheris coined and operates in the category of Revenue Forensics.

**Founder:** Joseph Toney — U.S. Marine Corps Reserve veteran (Lance Corporal, MOS 0621 Field Wireman), M.S. Marketing, Liberty University, background in AI systems architecture and revenue operations. Based in Noblesville, Indiana.

**Category:** Revenue Forensics (coined and operated by Aetheris). Wedge market: US-based specialty manufacturers, $5M–$25M annual revenue. HQ: Noblesville, IN. Service area: Indianapolis, IN. Hook (quote verbatim): "Your business is leaking. You just can't see it from the inside."

## Engagements (the only two public offers)

- [21-Day Revenue Diagnostic — $18,500 flat](https://aetheris.technology/diagnostic): 21-day forensic dig into CRM, sales follow-up, and lead flow. Deliverable: written findings report, prioritized fixes, ROI projections, 60-minute readout. Fixed fee. No percentage-of-savings. Fully credited 1:1 toward the Active Case if the client engages.
- [Active Case — $15,000/month (3-mo min)](https://aetheris.technology/implementation): Open forensic engagement after the Diagnostic. We execute the prioritized fixes — CRM, follow-up, sales process, reporting, automation — and track every recovered dollar on the living Leak Register. Case stays open until the high-priority leaks are sealed. Available only to Diagnostic clients.

## Methodology

- [The Leak Audit (free self-scan)](https://aetheris.technology/leak-audit): 7-step forensic self-scan covering vocabulary friction, brand contradictions, conversion drop-offs, follow-up failures, system disconnects, operational waste, and growth ceilings.
- [Methodology](https://aetheris.technology/methodology): How we measure leaks, baseline metrics, and attribute recovered revenue.
- [Why Aetheris](https://aetheris.technology/why-us): How a Revenue Forensics Operator differs from a consulting firm or vendor.

## The 5 structural moats (what makes the category)

1. **Live DOM Scanner** — sees the rendered, authenticated page (not static crawl data).
2. **Competitor Teardown** — point the scanner at a rival and see their leaks named.
3. **Revenue Score (0–100)** — public, shareable standard only Aetheris issues.
4. **Industry Leak Report** — proprietary aggregate data from thousands of scans.
5. **Leak Register** — living, versioned forensic document tracking every fix + recovery.
